records.observation: Official current scientific description supports IVF/pre-transfer sampling, limited testing for specific conditions or structural rearrangements and possible damage/inaccuracy. UK authorization information is not imported as German law.
Official glossary supports cell-targeted delivery of functional gene copies; successful DNA delivery alone is not inferred to establish expression, tissue reach or clinical benefit.

Historical WHO scientific overview links interference with hormonal function to possible adverse effects and exposure/evidence limits. No modern quantitative persistence or regulatory threshold is derived.
